agent.description: Agent or pipeline id providing the assistance. Required unless autonomy is person.

autonomy.description: person: no agent. propose: the agent prefills a proposal; the person confirms or overrides. approve: the agent does the work; the write waits in the approvals inbox. auto: the agent does the work through the Tool-Call Firewall.

end.description: End the run with a named outcome.

on.description: The outcome this branch handles. Check steps: pass / fail. Approval steps: approved / rejected. The publish check (WP-0714) verifies the outcome matches the step kind.

aggregate.description: per_item only: how the per-child results combine. all: the check passes only when every child passes. any: it passes when at least one child passes.

message.description: Shown when the check fails, with the reason.

scope.description: anchor: evaluate once against the anchor record and run data. per_item: evaluate once per child record, aggregated across children.

anchor_record.description: A $ reference naming the related record the child lane runs on. Example: $record.supplier_id.

lane_id.description: Id of the child lane to start.

compare_field.description: Field-to-field comparison: compare against this field's current value instead of the literal value.

field.description: Field reference: $record.<field>, $run_data.<field>, or $item.<field> inside a repeating step. Example: $record.status, $item.qty_received.

value.description: Literal value to compare against. Absent for is_empty / is_not_empty. in_list / not_in_list split on '|'.

outcome.description: Named outcome the run ends with. done is the outcome for a run that reaches the end; other names (for example held) end the run the same way. Recorded in run data and shown in the label.

expression.description: Narrow arithmetic grammar (ADR-0024 section 5): a sum of field references and numbers compared to a field reference or a number. Example: $item.qty_received + $item.qty_rejected <= $item.qty_ordered. Only a sum comparison is admitted in v1.

binds_to.description: Where the entered value goes: run_data.<field> or record.<field>. Inside a repeating step, record.<collection>[].<field> is the current child record's field.

type.description: Field type. date is a YYYY-MM-DD string.

description.description: One paragraph: what job this lane does, for whom.

excludes.description: Lane ids that may not run concurrently on the same anchor record.

id.description: Lane id, kebab-case with a lane- prefix. Example: lane-wh-receiving.

object_key.description: The Custom Object key the lane runs on. Example: purchase_order.

run_data.description: Declared schema for the lane's run data. Every value a person enters is stored in run data or mapped to a named record field.

stages.description: Ordered stages. Array order is the order; there is no order field.

start_condition.description: Optional lane start condition. If it fails, the run is refused with the reason and no run row is created.

status.description: Draft or Published. A lane with no published version cannot start a run.

version.description: Definition version. A run keeps the version it started with; a published lane is never edited in place.

message.description: Notification text. It may name the anchor record and the step; it never carries secrets.

to_role.description: Role to notify, as the role's key in the workspace.

field.description: Field path on the anchor record holding the child array. Example: lines (the purchase order's lines).

item_id_field.description: Field on each child holding its id. Default: id.

action_index.description: Position of the action in the workflow's actions array. Workflow actions have no stable ids in v1, so the index is the reference; the publish check verifies it.

workflow_id.description: Id of the workflow whose action this step replaces. Example: wf-wh-01.

fields.description: Declared run-data fields. The runtime validates entered values against these.

per_child.description: When true, the value is an object mapping child record id to a value of this type (for repeating steps).

type.description: Value type. date is a YYYY-MM-DD string.

entry_condition.description: Optional stage entry condition. If it fails, the stage is skipped.

name.description: Display name, one chevron in the stage bar. Example: Verify.

skip_condition.description: Optional stage skip condition. If it holds, the stage is skipped.

steps.description: Ordered steps. Array order is the order; steps are sequential in v1.

branches.description: Check and approval steps only: declared routes from the step's outcome. Every branch has a declared way out (target or end).

check.description: Check steps only: the automatic validation and its outcome.

child_lane.description: Optional: this step starts another lane on a related record and waits for its outcome (WP-0716).

description.description: What the person does in this step.

ends_run.description: Optional: completing this step ends the run with the named outcome instead of advancing.

fields.description: Form steps only: the fields the person fills. Each field binds to run data or a named record field.

id.description: Step id, unique within the lane. Example: confirm-arrival.

kind.description: Step kind. Notification is never a kind; it is an automatic effect (notify).

name.description: Display name. Example: Confirm shipment arrived.

notify.description: Automatic notification on step completion. Notification is an effect, never a step.

repeat_over.description: Form, record and agent steps only: repeat this step over child records of the anchor record.

replaces.description: Workflow actions this step replaces. Only those are not fired for this step's writes; all other workflow actions fire normally.

required.description: A required step must be complete and valid before the next unlocks, and cannot be skipped. Only an optional step can be skipped.

role.description: The role that may do this step, as the role's key in the workspace (demo role ids in the demo, the core role model in the editions). A check step has no role.

validation.description: Optional rule that must hold before the step completes. A failure blocks advance with the message shown.

writes.description: Record and approval steps only: the governed Action Type calls this step performs. All-or-nothing, repeat-safe (WP-0141).

message.description: Shown when the validation fails; the step does not advance.

action_type.description: Governed Action Type id. The catalog is WP-0705's; the ids in the example are provisional until it adopts them.

inputs.description: Mapping from input name to a literal JSON value or a $ reference ($record.<field>, $run_data.<field>, $item.<field> inside a repeating step).

description: The shared Process Lane definition for desktop, Team Workspace and the online demo. Single source of truth per ADR-0015 and ADR-0024. Snake case to match the desktop. Covers: REQ-LANE-001, REQ-LANE-003 (WP-0701). A lane compiles to an execution graph with source kind 'lane' (ADR-0024 section 3). Breaking changes bump the format_version major version and are a new work package, never a silent edit.

format_version.description: Semver of this format. Breaking changes bump the major version.

title: Lanesra OS Process Lane format
